Aggregation.description: Single aggregation rule configured by alert severity.

GroupBy.description: Alert group fields, default [rule_id+region]. Currently only supports: 1. rule_id+region grouping, i.e., default grouping by severity. 2. Any rule_id+region+* grouping, i.e., each faulty resource forms a separate group, notification cycle is not affected by other faulty resources; in this mode, GroupWait/GroupInterval are not effective, default is 0. 3. rule_id+region+keys grouping based on actual alert group fields, grouped by key match and value. For example, rule_id+region+namespace+cluster+pod, each namespace+cluster+pod combination forms a separate group, notification cycle is not affected by other faulty resources; this method requires configuring a fallback aggregation strategy.

GroupInterval.description: Alert group wait interval for the 2nd to Nth times, in seconds, range is 5 seconds to 24 hours. If there is a new alert or recovery in the alert group, send immediately after GroupInterval and recalculate RepeatInterval.

GroupWait.description: Alert group initial wait time, in seconds, range is 5 seconds to 24 hours. If not specified, defaults to GroupInterval.

Level.description: Alert severity, supports p0/p1/p2/all. all indicates the fallback aggregation strategy, meaning alerts are aggregated without distinguishing severity, but messages are still sent separately by severity. If not all p0/p1/p2 levels are configured, the "all" fallback strategy must be configured.

RepeatDowngrade.description: Notification frequency reduction configuration. Note: P0 does not support notification frequency reduction, while P1/P2 do.

RepeatInterval.description: Alert repeat notification interval, in seconds, range is 1 minute to 24 hours.

Name.description: Attribute name. CloudMonitor supports Namespace, SubNamespace; VMP supports WorkspaceID; Cloud probe supports DetectTaskID; APMPlus Server supports ServiceName, Workspace; APMPlus Client TBD.

RepeatDowngrade.description: Notification frequency reduction configuration. Note: P0 does not support notification frequency reduction, while P1/P2 do.

MaxRepeatInterval.description: Maximum repeat send interval, in seconds. Frequency reduction stops when this value is exceeded. Default is 24 hours (86400 seconds).

Mode.description: Frequency reduction mode, currently only supports doubled. doubled means each time the frequency is reduced, the repeat send interval is multiplied by 2 until MaxRepeatInterval.

Aggregations.description: List of aggregation rules configured by alert level

AssociatedAttributes.description: Associated attributes. RuleIDs: list of associated alert strategy IDs.

CreateTime.description: Creation time, Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

IsDefault.description: Whether it is the default aggregation strategy.

Type.description: Aggregation strategy type. custom: custom; bound: bound to alert strategy (1:1).

UpdateTime.description: Update time, Unix timestamp in milliseconds
